items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: I used to play with George's band.

ctx.x: Um, well, um, now, can you remember George Lewis at that time?

George, I've been knowing George all my days. But George, like, uh, he wasn't over there at the time. We were over there, you know what I mean? But I've been knowing George. I used to play with George's band. We had a band with Chris Kelly. And, uh, the rest of the guys there, it was, I can't think all, all the fellas that, uh, we had at that time, you know. But I know Chris Kelly was waiting with us and the same, uh, Jim Robison. Jim Robison was working with us too in that band, you know. And, uh, we did good…
Now that was late then, wasn't it? That would have been later. That would have been after. That would have been after, say, in the mid-20s or something.

items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: the band I heard you in the night before last was George Lewis which had done Preservation Hall.

ctx.x: there on that side. No, no. We didn't have too many, but we played for them though. He did play some of them. Yeah, because they had a place out in Covenant they called it Romeo Park. See they had a dance hall. You heard about the Romeo? No, I don't know about that. Well they had a park there where the boys used to play ball and we used to play for the ball games and sometimes we'd give the dance right after the ball game like that while we'd play the dance for them like that.
I was wondering, oh excuse me, the band I heard you in the night before last was George Lewis which had done Preservation Hall. How did that sound compared to this band? Was there

much difference in the music faster, slower? Yeah, lots of difference because the music wasn't that fast so like we played over there, you know what I mean? And you take the trumpet like I told you before, there's no man can fit in there like that boy there. You see what I'm talking about? Nelson's a good man on that but these boys was together. You understand? They'd been working together God knows how long. And this band was just put together. Of course the other night you had a piano too, and there's no piano.…
